what_happened: Athena accepted a reading for job 20261023-234149-jcd2 (a retry of nvbb) that edits the shared verifier prompt. The study verifier already composes that frame at 1296 of 1300 tokens, so any addition fails the budgets test. The producer kept trying to make the edit fit until its 1800 s deadline. Two attempts failed, about 80 minutes in all. The operator logged this as a mistake. The job field is empty, so this is an intervention note, not a failed job record.
cause: The reader and planner accept prompt edits without knowing how much room each prompt set has left. The budget limits are enforced only by a test the producer meets after it starts work. Nothing shows the remaining headroom to the reading or plan stage, and nothing compares the size of a proposed addition to it. An impossible edit therefore reaches the producer, which cannot succeed and has no signal to stop early.
prevention: Add a pre-dispatch check for any job whose reading or plan touches prompt files. It computes the remaining token budget of every prompt set that composes each touched file, which is the same data the budgets test prints. It puts those figures in front of the reader and planner. It refuses or sends back a plan whose estimated addition exceeds the headroom, unless the plan also removes or moves text to make room or places the addition in a set that has room. The producer would then start only on an edit that can pass the budgets test.
proposed_request: Add a pre-dispatch prompt-budget check to Athena. When a job's accepted reading or plan edits a prompt file, compute the remaining token budget for every prompt set that includes that file, using the same counting as `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`. Show the figures to the reader and planner stages. Have the critic or admission send back any plan whose estimated addition exceeds the remaining room in any affected set, unless the plan also frees room or puts the addition in a set that has room. Done when: (1) a plan that adds text to the study verifier frame, now at 1296 of 1300 tokens, is sent back before the producer runs; (2) a plan that fits within the remaining room is admitted; (3) the budgets test still passes. Then retry job 20261023-234149-jcd2 with its addition placed where there is room.
